captions.detailed: A pair of birdwatching roof-prism binoculars featuring a straight-through black barrel housing. Two main optical barrels are joined by a central hinge, with a cylindrical focus knob positioned on the central bridge. The front objective lenses and rear eyepieces feature a light teal glass material, while the body has a matte black finish with ribbed grip textures on the outer sides.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a roof-prism binocular with two parallel optical barrels connected by a central hinge. Ensure it features a central cylindrical focus knob, ribbed side grip details, and light teal glass lenses on both the objective and eyepiece ends.
captions.factory: The object is constructed by defining the main central bridge and hinge components as box and cylinder primitives. Two identical barrel assemblies are created on either side, using cylinders for the optical tubes and smaller cylinders for the eyepiece extensions. Ribbed grip textures are generated by repeating thin rectangular boxes on the outer sides of each barrel. Glass lenses are modeled as thin cylinders with a distinct teal material and positioned at the front and back of each barrel assembly.
